label: Bible Study
prompt: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a _____ upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verse: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
note: At Jesus' baptism the Spirit descends in bodily shape like a dove — and the Father speaks.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places _____: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
verse: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
note: Spoken to Cyrus: God goes on ahead, straightening crooked places and breaking gates of brass.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the _____ person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verse: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
note: Peter calls Noah 'the eighth person' — one of eight saved on the ark — and a preacher of righteousness.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And _____ not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verse: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
note: Only a person can be grieved — and the same Spirit is the seal that keeps you until redemption day.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I the LORD search the heart, I try the _____, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
verse: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
note: God searches the heart and tries the 'reins' — the old English word for kidneys, pictured as the seat of hidden motives.
